newsitem.title: USA: Centennial HealthCare buys Complex Care.
newsitem.headline: Centennial HealthCare buys Complex Care.

text.p: Centennial HealthCare Corp said on Monday that it had acquired substantially all the business and assets of Complex Care Inc, a privately owned provider of occupational and speech therapy services.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed, but Centennial said Complex Care, located in Avon, Connecticut, had annual revenues in 1996 of $12.5 million.

"The acquisition of Complex Care provides the company with additional therapy contracts in the region and complements our existing contract therapy operations in New Jersey," said Centennial President J. Stephen Eaton. "One of Centennial's primary objectives is the continued expansion of its specialty healthcare services."
Centennial HealthCare Corp provides long-term health care services for elderly and post-acute patients.
